question: Should a Gateway method advertised since 2026.7 be removed immediately, or should OpenClaw retain and deprecate it through a compatibility/versioned transition?
rationale: The branch’s consumer sweep can establish internal usage but cannot decide the public upgrade contract for independently deployed Gateway clients.

options.title: Deprecate before removal
options.body: Keep `sessions.observer.ask` available for a documented transition period while directing supported clients to the companion route.

options.title: Approve immediate removal
options.body: Confirm that the 2026.7 method was not a supported released client contract and accept unknown-method failures for any remaining callers.

recommendation.title: Deprecate before removal
recommendation.body: Keep `sessions.observer.ask` available for a documented transition period while directing supported clients to the companion route.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and proposed work owns the observer-to-companion transition and can clarify the intended Gateway contract.
